data.bottom_line: Snow coverage is still quite low, and triggering an avalanche would be difficult, if not impossible, in most places. Wind-drifted features below ridges or steep rollovers are the few hazards that warrant caution, especially above terrain traps. Consider avoiding them to help stay safe.
